entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this useless VeloBand sensor. I want my money back, and I want it now.
I can certainly look into starting a return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

There's no 'issue'! I just **changed my mind**, alright? It was a stupid **impulse buy** and I just **don't use it**. It's been sitting in the box. This shouldn't be a 20-questions interrogation, just process the return!
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I see here that the order was delivered 20 days ago. Let me just pull up the policy for that...

What is there to pull up?! Your website said 90 days! Don't try to pull a fast one on me. I want to speak to your manager right now! This is unbelievable. I'll plaster this all over your social media.

Sir, there's no need for that, please allow me one moment to check. I apologize for the delay... Okay, I am pulling up our internal knowledge base now. Let's see... Ah, you are absolutely correct. My apologies, I was thinking of the policy for a different product line.

Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor is a standard item and falls under our 90-day return policy. Since you're at day 20, you are well within the window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund immediately.
About time! See? I told you. It shouldn't be that damn difficult. So, what now? Are you sending me a label or what?

Yes, of course. I have just processed the return authorization in our system. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and return instructions within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued to the original payment method.
Fine. Just make sure that email actually shows up.
It will. I've confirmed the request has been sent. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Understood. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
